svg.title: LioK — a sakura-themed GitHub portfolio
svg.desc: Roblox scripting, music tools, macOS apps, and automation by LioK251. Featured projects: mp3converter, LumenWallpapers, potassium_mcp_bridge, and steam_discordbot. Public GitHub statistics as of September 13, 2026.

g.text: I like scripting on Lego games and building useful things.
My projects span Roblox, music tools, macOS apps,
Audio and video to MIDI, powered by Transkun.
QWERTY piano sheets, playback, and a local MIDI library.
A little more life on the macOS desktop.
Native live wallpapers, procedural scenes, and local media.
Connecting Roblox clients to AI tools through MCP.
Instance inspection, script tools, and a WebSocket bridge.
Steam manifest lookups, right inside Discord.
Search by app name or ID, with downloads and usage stats.
